language.note: DTU currently teaches General Engineering fully in English at Lyngby. Autumn 2027 delivery is not separately confirmed; recheck by 15 January 2027.

selection.description: Quota 1 ranks eligible applicants on converted Danish GPA. Historical cut-offs are not required IB totals.
Quota 2 gives great weight to motivation: an English personal statement of 1–2 pages and CV.
Quota 2 considers maths, physics and chemistry levels/results; biology and computer science may count.
Relevant work, additional education and other documented activities contribute to the overall assessment.

requirements.label: Full IB Diploma, or a Course Results supplementary qualification confirmed by DTU

alternatives.label: Full IB Diploma with at least 24 points
Course Results plus supplementary study: individual DTU confirmation

requirements.note: Course Results alone do not qualify for this BSc. DTU specifies one supplementary A-level and one B-level subject; national guidance has additional routes and constraints. Obtain individual confirmation before relying on supplementation; an existing qualification is not automatically rejected.

requirements.label: Documented English proficiency
requirements.note: The English-test exemption requires a qualifying IB Diploma and a passed English subject equivalent to Danish English B or A; the separate English B subject requirement still applies. Course Results are not named for this exemption: confirm with DTU or supply an approved test. Otherwise IELTS Academic 6.5, Cambridge C1/C2 180 or TOEFL iBT 88 / 4.5 under the updated scale after 21 January (year unstated); check the current table. No IELTS One Skill Retake; online verification required. Where DTU grants conditional admission pending an English test, upload the passed result through UnistartDTU by 1 September (annual rule; confirm 2027).

requirements.label: Quota 1: ranked on converted GPA
requirements.note: Quota 1 eligible applicants are ranked by their converted qualifying-exam average; historical cut-offs do not predict this intake.

requirements.label: Quota 2: motivation, personal statement and CV
requirements.note: The English statement is 1–2 A4 pages; explain why General Engineering and how your qualifications match.

requirements.label: Quota 2: maths, physics and chemistry grades and levels
requirements.note: Biology and computer science may also count. These are ranking factors alongside the mandatory specific subject requirements.

requirements.label: Quota 2: relevant work, further education and other activities
requirements.note: Document relevant experience. Plan supporting uploads by 1 April unless DTU specifically permits later evidence.

officialRequirementsText.text: Mathematics A-level, English B-level, Physics B-level, Chemistry B-level

outcomePathway.furtherStudy: Most graduates continue to an MSc in Engineering. Available masters depend on specialisation and individual prerequisites; admission is not automatic.
outcomePathway.workRoutes: The degree develops broad engineering skills through projects. Company projects may be arranged with supervisors; employment is not guaranteed.
